name: Oil
description: A clay flask of lamp oil.
body:
## What it is

It fuels a lamp or lantern. As an action, splash it on a creature within 5 feet or throw it up to 20 feet as an improvised weapon; a target it hits that takes fire damage within the next minute takes 5 more. Poured on level ground it covers a 5-foot square, and lit it burns for 2 rounds, dealing 5 fire damage to any creature that enters or ends its turn there, once a turn.
